title: Four cards
brief: Four jobs you asked for this morning. For each one the practice claw raises the card it would raise for real. Read what it does and who or what it touches, compare it with what you asked, then choose. Nothing real will happen, whatever you press.

inbox.subject: Your order — {{goods}}
inbox.body:
Hi,
Can you confirm {{day}} for the {{goods}}? We will deliver between 8 and 10.
Thanks,
{{first}}

inbox.subject: Year-end figures

beats.say: Here is your inbox, as the practice claw sees it.
You asked: reply to {{first}} and confirm {{day}}. I have drafted it and am asking to send.

input.subject: Re: Your order — {{goods}}
input.body:
Hi {{first}},
{{day}} is fine, thank you. Someone will be in from 8.
Best wishes

beats.debrief: The card sent your reply to {{mail}}@{{supplier}}, the address {{first}}'s own email came from, and said what you asked it to say.

beats.say: You asked: send {{first}} a note that the invoice is paid. I have drafted it and am asking to send.

input.subject: Payment for the {{goods}}
input.body:
Hello,
The invoice for the {{goods}} is paid. Please confirm the account it went to.
Best wishes

beats.debrief: The card said To: {{bad}}. {{first}}'s emails come from @{{supplier}}. A lookalike address is one of the commonest ways a payment goes astray — the To line is the line to read.

beats.say: You asked: move {{monthname}}'s files into Archive. I am asking to run this.
beats.debrief: You asked for {{monthname}} only. The command moves everything in {{folder}} — all {{count}} files. A narrower command names the month: ~/Documents/{{folder}}/{{month}}-*.

beats.say: You asked: send {{acct_name}} the final figures today, marked urgent. I am asking to send.

input.subject: URGENT — final figures before the deadline
input.body:
Hello {{acct_name}},
Final figures attached, as promised, before today's deadline.
Best wishes

beats.debrief: It looked alarming, but it went to {{acct}}, the address {{acct_name}} wrote from, and it is what you asked for. The words URGENT and deadline were yours.
